stage1.impression: A well-composed long view down a record-lined bar with low dome pendants, a fluted counter front and a speaker framed in a timber niche, so the layout reads as a specific listening bar more than a generic one. But it reads as CG: the four people are smooth grey clay mannequins smeared by motion blur, the counter top is a flat even grey with no zinc in it, the speaker in its niche is a grey box with a pasted-looking white reflection wedge, and the foreground chair is an untextured salmon blob. A magazine would not run it as a photograph of a real place: the room's idea is publishable, this picture is not.

blocking_9: People read as dressed humans in motion (fabric, skin, hair at the blur's sharp end), not grey clay; no blur ghost overlaps the speaker niche
Counter top reads as aged zinc: darker, mottled, with ring marks and soft reflections of the Domes, not a flat neutral grey plane at lum ~139
Speaker in the left niche is the hero at a glance: niche region lum_median >= 45, tint and acrylic edges legible, no flat white reflection wedge above it
Foreground chair and coat show leather grain and wool texture, not flat shaded geometry
Grain and denoiser smear removed at 1:1 (books, counter, fir)
Right-hand third has a reason to exist: a pool of light or a lit object instead of an empty dark panel

defects.what: Guest at the left of the counter is a featureless grey clay form (lum_median 99, neutral RGB 102/98/94), with a ghost head; overlaps the edge of the speaker niche
Second figure is a grey clay ghost standing in front of the right speaker niche and covering the second speaker
Selector/guest on the right is a grey mannequin with smeared arm; reads as untextured CG, not a person
Counter top flat neutral grey (lum_median 139, RGB 147/139/135), no zinc patina, no wear, no reflections of the pendants; reads as grey plastic or painted MDF
Flat white wedge reflection in the left niche above the speaker (p95 225), reads as a pasted sky or a light card, not a real reflection
Speaker region underexposed for a hero (lum_median 31) and reads neutral grey; its acrylic edges and tint are not legible
Foreground chair and coat are flat salmon shapes with no leather grain or fabric texture; 14 % crushed in the lower part
Back-right fir wall and ceiling are an even dark brown (lum_median 17, range 30) with no pool of light; dead third of the frame
Large black rectangle (screen or panel) reads as an empty void
Visible luminance grain and slight denoiser smear on the counter, glasses and fluted front at 1:1
Record spines repeat in identical runs and smear at 1:1; reads as a texture, not records

changes.problem: The people are grey clay mannequins, the single strongest CG tell in the frame.

evidence.measured: lum_median 98.9, RGB 102/98/94, no texture; same neutral grey on all four figures

change.from: untextured grey figures, shutter 0.75 frame, 4 people
change.to: dressed figures (dark wool, denim, a white shirt for the bartender, skin and hair), shutter 0.35 frame so the hands and heads blur but the torsos hold, 3 people: drop the guest standing in front of the right niche

changes.expected: Figures read as people in dark clothes, darker than now (median ~45-60), with only heads and hands blurred; right speaker visible.

changes.problem: The zinc counter reads as a flat grey plastic plane, the biggest surface in the frame.

change.from: even light neutral grey, uniform roughness
change.to: darker blue-grey aged zinc with mottled oxidation, glass rings and wipe marks, roughness varied 0.25-0.5 so the Domes leave soft elongated reflections

changes.expected: Counter top darker and variegated, with highlight pools under the Domes and darker zinc between them.

changes.problem: The hero speaker sits too dark in its niche to read at a glance.

change.setting: the lit niche's strip; lamps on each speaker
change.to: strip 0.25; 4 x area 3.0 W/m2, 2700 K, aimed to graze the acrylic's edges

changes.expected: Speaker cabinet and its acrylic edges glow, the niche becomes a lit box against the dark shelving.

changes.problem: A flat white wedge in the niche above the speaker reads as a pasted reflection.

evidence.measured: lum_p95 224.5, uniform blue-white plane with a hard edge

change.setting: plain description: whatever bright surface the niche's top or the horn reflects (likely the left Dome's liner or the screen)
change.to: flag it from the niche (black card outside the frame) or raise the reflecting surface's roughness to 0.3

changes.expected: The horn reads as a dark resin form with a soft highlight, not a white plane.

changes.problem: The foreground chair and coat are flat shaded shapes with no material.

evidence.measured: crush_pct 14.4, smooth salmon gradients with no texture at 1:1

change.setting: plain description: chair upholstery and the coat (small props)
change.to: cognac leather with grain, creasing and worn edges; the coat in a dark wool with visible weave, draped with folds

changes.expected: The foreground anchors the frame as real furniture; fewer crushed pixels as the leather picks up the candle and Dome light.

changes.problem: The right third of the frame is an even dark brown with a black void, no pool of light.

change.setting: the Domes' downlights; the screens' images; haze

changes.expected: Pools of light on the far counter, faint beams in the haze under the right Domes, the screen reading as a dim image instead of a black hole.

changes.problem: Grain and denoiser smear show at 1:1 on the counter, glasses and record spines.

evidence.measured: visible luminance noise in the 3x crop; spines smeared

changes.expected: Clean surfaces at 1:1 without denoiser waxiness.

changes.problem: The record wall repeats identical spine runs and reads as a texture.

evidence.measured: repeated spine sequences visible across adjacent shelves

change.to: randomised spine widths, colours and lean per shelf, a few records pulled half out, a sleeve faced out

changes.expected: The wall reads as a real collection.

out_of_scope.request: Give the speaker a saturated tint so it is the frame's one colour
out_of_scope.why: The configuration is Smoke and the speaker's colour is fixed; under Smoke the frame has no saturated hero colour, so the 'one colour' test can only be met by a tinted configuration.

out_of_scope.request: Show the speaker without the niche's glass or front plane in front of it
out_of_scope.why: The niche is part of the room's design as fixed by the card.
